relation: one declared event authorizes one entity to leave a specific source state and enter one specific target state while the entity identity remains stable

stageEvents.observable: the stable entity is visibly located in the declared source state and the target state is inactive
one named event arrives at the transition gate while the entity remains in the source state
the event unlocks exactly one directed source-to-target transition
the same entity leaves the source state and becomes active in the target state
the target state is confirmed as current and the triggering event remains traceable

limits: exactly one stable entity, one source state, one trigger event, and one target state per instance
the entity remains in the source state until the declared event authorizes the transition
the transition is directed from the declared source state to the declared target state
the entity identity remains visibly continuous across the transition
the confirmed target state retains a visible trace of the triggering event
no scheduled multi-step progression, binary condition branch, parallel join, retry loop, feedback loop, or untriggered state change claim

checks: exact endpoint and reverse seek inspection
